name: howtoai
description: HowToAI skills: skill-builder (create, change, or repair a skill, tool, or automated procedure), skill-finder (find existing skills, plugins, and tools across approved marketplaces), skill-audit (audit the Claude environment and its workspaces), skill-design (build and review HTML pages in the HowToAI house design), brain-dump (sort a brain dump into the right project's plan doc), grilling (the shared method for asking the user the decisions a task needs), and handover (move the work to a new session, with the context the user chooses)
